body:
#### What type of PR is this?
/kind failing-test
/kind flake

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
1. registry.k8s.io/galera-install:0.1 is not published anymore and probably has not been for quite a long. So the entire mysql-galera suite was removed.
2. docker.io/library/java:openjdk-8-jre was removed a while back (https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/505). Additionally, openjdk images are entirely deprecated (https://hub.docker.com/_/openjdk) and will likely be removed soon. The current zookeeper relies heavily on jre8, which is not available anymore so dropping the entire suite as well.

#### Which issue(s) this PR is related to:
Fixes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/140910

#### Special notes for your reviewer:
/assign @dims

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?
```release-note
NONE
```
